verdict.rationale: Saved snippets and templates are a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers Graph API building blocks: drafting messages, adding attachments, and sending mail. Nothing documents a user-facing saved-template or snippet feature with variables and attachments, and building-block APIs earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
